capabilities: show a full-content overlay when single-clicking a text-based canvas node
open a canvas node's note in a new tab on double-click
toggle each behavior and adjust overlay size and read-only behavior in settings
disambiguation: Not a tool for expanding or rewriting note content; it only adds viewing and navigation mouse controls on canvas nodes.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the author solicits Ko-fi donations for future updates.
intentEvidence: adds new convenient mouse controls inside canvas
problem: Canvas nodes are often too small to read their full text, and opening a note from a canvas for editing takes several steps.
summary: Canvas mouse-control plugin that shows a full-content overlay on single-click and opens a node's note in a new tab on double-click.
